id: July 24, 2009 - To Open: The Complete Instruction

metadata.title: July 24, 2009 - To Open: The Complete Instruction
metadata.author: By Cathy Allis / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: One may be out of date
Vintage car named for an explorer
It's beaten to your door, idiomatically
Subject of a famous Hokusai print
Toilet bowl cleaner: "Squeeze sides and turn"...
Like uniform number 42, in major league baseball
Soup can: "Lift tab to rim. Pull up and back"...
Box of sugar: "Push in tab. Tear back"...
Abbr. for a person lacking three names
Individual string cheese: "Safety first! Open with hands, not teeth"...
It's between the Missouri and the Mississippi
Windshield washer fluid: "Push down and twist"...
At right angles to the keel
Engaged in a war of the words
Ibuprofen: "Line up arrows on cap and bottle. Push cap with thumbs"...
Series set at the Princeton-Plainsboro Teaching Hospital
It might go over your head
Cracker box: "Slide finger under flap and loosen gently"...
